content: On Wednesday, October 24, 2012, at 9:00 AM, Dr. Joo-Yong Hahn will discuss a prospective, randomized trial investigating the effects of post-conditioning in patients experiencing ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The embargo for this data will lift on Thursday, October 25, 2012, at 11:55 AM. At 4:30 PM, Dr. William F. Fearon will discuss the FAME 2 trial, which is a prospective, randomized study assessing the cost-effectiveness of fractional flow reserve (FFR)-guided percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in patients with stable coronary artery disease. The embargo for this information will lift on Wednesday, October 24, 2012, at 11:20 AM. At 5:40 PM, Dr. Ajay Kirtane will provide a daily wrap-up of the TCT events. On Thursday, October 25, 2012, at 10:00 AM, Dr. Julinda Mehilli will present the ISAR-LEFT MAIN 2 trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing everolimus-eluting stents to zotarolimus-eluting stents in patients with unprotected left main coronary artery disease. The embargo for this data will lift on Wednesday, October 24, 2012, at 12:00 PM. At 11:30 AM, Dr. Thomas Zeller will discuss a prospective, randomized trial comparing nitinol stents to balloon angioplasty in patients with obstructive popliteal lesions. The embargo for this information will lift on Wednesday, October 24, 2012, at 12:50 PM. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Stefan James will provide a wrap-up of the TCT events from a Scandinavian perspective. At 3:00 PM, Dr. Gennaro Sardella will deliver a TCT wrap-up in Italian. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Ajay Kirtane will again provide a daily wrap-up of the TCT events. At 4:30 PM, Dr. Rogerio Sarmento will present a TCT wrap-up in Portuguese. At 5:00 PM, Dr. Ivo Bernat will discuss the STEMI-RADIAL trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing radial access to femoral access in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The embargo for this data will lift on Friday, October 26, 2012, at 11:55 AM. On Friday, October 26, 2012, at 9:00 AM, Dr. Gregg W. Stone will present the MASTER trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing a PET micronet mesh-covered stent to standard stents in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The embargo for this information will lift on Wednesday, October 24, 2012, at 11:40 AM. At 9:30 AM, Dr. Gregg W. Stone will also discuss the ADAPT-DES One Year study, a large-scale, multicenter, prospective, observational study examining the impact of clopidogrel hyporesponsiveness on patient outcomes. The embargo for this data will lift on Thursday, October 25, 2012, at 12:15 PM. At 10:00 AM, Dr. Harvey White will provide a TCT wrap-up from a Pacific Rim perspective. At 10:30 AM, Dr. Holger Thiele will present findings from the AIDA STEMI MRI substudy, which is part of a prospective, randomized trial investigating the use of intracoronary abciximab in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The embargo for this information will lift on Thursday, October 25, 2012, at 12:30 PM. At 2:15 PM, Dr. Robert A. Byrne will discuss the ISAR-DESIRE 3 trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing paclitaxel-eluting balloons, paclitaxel-eluting stents, and balloon angioplasty for the treatment of restenosis in “limus”-eluting coronary stents. The embargo for this data will lift on Friday, October 26, 2012, at 11:35 AM. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Sigmund Silber will provide a TCT wrap-up in German.
